protocol: Same point forecasts and dates for every interval method. At least 30 matured errors. EWMA daily dollar scale lambda 0.94 known at origin, floor 0.25 USD; horizon scale sqrt(h). Finite quantile uses capped ceil((n+1)q) empirical rank. Adaptive alpha starts at .10 with step .01, clipped [.01,.30], updating once per matured previously issued interval. Candidate selection minimizes mean 90% interval score using only pre-2026 target outcomes; every 2026 candidate is still disclosed. Width-only controls match pre-2026 candidate coverage, never 2026 outcomes.
limitations: Post-hoc methods were designed after inspecting 2026 undercoverage; pre-2026 selection does not make 2026 an untouched validation set.
Revised histories and overlapping forecast targets remain; no finite-sample or conditional 90% guarantee is claimed.
Finite empirical quantile caps ranks at available sample size rather than returning infinite bounds.
Higher coverage can cost substantial width; compare the proper interval score, both tails, widths and frozen inflation controls.
Bootstrap intervals are exploratory, serial-dependence-sensitive and unadjusted for multiple comparisons.
No new prospective outcomes have been scored; updated legacy-origin ranges are research projections, not a new forward experiment.
